profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: Full stack engineer with a frontend lean and a thing for building stuff that actually works. Six years in, mostly in e-commerce, but the problems I get most excited about live at the intersection of design, engineering, and AI. I've built custom apps, 3D configurators, autonomous AI agents, and everything in between. I like owning things end to end and I work best when I have room to figure it out. Outside of work I'm building my own projects and competing in osu at a level that requires an embarrassing amount of dedication.
